title.rendered: Sherwood Education Foundation Kicks Off Its Annual Clicking 4 Kids Campaign

content.rendered:
Thursday November 20th, the Sherwood Education Foundation (SEF) officially launches its annual Clicking 4 Kids Campaign, which will run through Friday, December 5, 2025. SEF was established to enrich and enhance the quality of education in the Sherwood School District by distributing funds via teacher grants. As we embark on the season of giving, please consider contributing to the educational excellence of our students by scanning the QR code or the direct link here.

Your support is greatly appreciated to help make Sherwood the best place to learn!
